cohort: 39 pre-eclamptic patients in labor or about to undergo cesarean delivery (cases) and 58 normotensive pregnant women admitted within the same period (controls).
finding: Serum iron and ferritin levels were significantly higher in pre-eclamptic patients compared to normotensive pregnant women.
gest_age: Recorded, but no significant difference between groups
birth_weight: Recorded, but no significant difference between groups
